verdict.rationale: Edge0 ships its own `edge0 serve` command that exposes an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint on localhost, which is the standard interface coding agents use to plug in a model backend. However, nothing documents an actual coding-agent integration or the agent-critical API features such a backend needs, so suitability as a working agent backend is only implied. Missing for 10: documented coding-agent setup or tested integrations, tool/function-calling support, streaming and other agent-required API features, and hands-on corroboration of agent use.
